questions.Q1: Does an explicit current/previous observed hidden-state correction add value beyond an encoder already using prefix history?
questions.Q2: Does fixed time/quantity score separation add value over generic retrieval from 64 learned static prototypes with top-4?

assumptions: Project architecture details supplied by parent frozen-design context, not independently code-audited here
MLP8 structure evidence and CNNGRU54 retrieval evidence are separate

sources.title: The Neural Hawkes Process: A Neurally Self-Modulating Multivariate Point Process
sources.finding: A continuous-time recurrent hidden state represents past event order and timing and determines intensity.

sources.title: Transformer Hawkes Process
sources.finding: Causal self-attention accesses historical events; future positions are masked.
sources.novelty_implication: Distinguish extra correction path from historical attention.

sources.title: Self-Attentive Hawkes Process
sources.finding: Time-encoded event representations are attention-weighted to parameterize history-dependent intensity.
sources.novelty_implication: Temporal information in history attention is established.

sources.title: Transformer Embeddings of Irregularly Spaced Events and Their Participants
sources.finding: Continuous-time event queries attend to past event representations; layer embeddings include residual connections.
sources.novelty_implication: Residual plus history is not itself new; exact path differs.

sources.title: Titans: Learning to Memorize at Test Time
sources.finding: Context-updated neural memory and input-independent persistent parameters are distinct.
sources.novelty_implication: Static prototype retrieval is not test-time neural memory updating.

sources.title: Augmenting Self-attention with Persistent Memory
sources.finding: Input-independent learned key/value vectors augment attention.
sources.novelty_implication: Learned static task memory is established.

sources.title: Large Memory Layers with Product Keys
sources.finding: Learned query selects top-k trainable memory keys and softmax-weights their values.
sources.novelty_implication: Top-k weighted learned memory retrieval is established.

synthesis.Q1_scope: Task-specific benefit of explicit current/previous-state correction beyond prefix encoder and active-capacity-matched current-only correction
synthesis.Q2_scope: Benefit of constrained time/quantity score design beyond weighted and same-information same-active-budget generic retrieval
forbidden_inferences: two independent contributions from combined score alone

recommended_contract_checks: Match encoder, output head, data, active capacity, initialization/RNG, optimizer and selection policy
Separate no correction, current-only active-budget control, current-plus-previous correction
Consider simple lag-1 concatenate/project control before attributing benefit to complex correction
Document observed-event indexing, boundaries, masking and residual initialization
Match mean/weighted/fixed/generic input access, bank64, top4 and value pathway
Match fixed512 and generic active parameter budget; existing generic521 is not exact match
Record score normalization, temperature, fixed coefficient provenance and tie handling
Check conditional algebraic equivalence of weighted two-view dot products and concatenated single dot product
Separate selection effect from aggregation effect with fixed-index/fixed-aggregation diagnostic controls
Use 2x2 correction-by-retrieval contrast for main effects and interaction
Keep full/tail quantity and same-selected-epoch TimeNLL plus same-GPU cost
Do not treat reused exposed Test as new independent evaluation
